info.name: BrewLite Full API & E2E Business Flows (59/59 Endpoints)
info.description:
Bộ Postman Collection hoàn chỉnh bao phủ 100% (59/59) API backend BrewLite:
- Folder 00: Warm-up & System Health Check
- Folder 01: Luồng MVP Assignment 1 (Menu -> Register/Login -> Profile -> Order -> Payment -> Barista KDS -> Completed)
- Folder 02: Task 10 nâng cao (Idempotency Replay, Voucher BREW20, Cancel+Restock, Payment Fail+Retry+Delete, Loyalty Redeem, Oversell 400)
- Folder 03: ZaloPay Sandbox Flow (Create, Status, Confirm, Cancel, IPN Invalid MAC)
- Folder 04: Admin Full CRUD Menu, Size Pricing, Ingredients + Restock + SetStock + Logs, BOM Recipes, Toppings, Vouchers, Dashboard
- Folder 05: Admin Full CRUD Staff & Customers + Tự dọn sạch tài khoản test
- Folder 06: Bảo mật, RBAC (401/403), State Machine Guard (400), DTO Validation (400/409), Idempotency Conflict

Lưu ý: /auth/login và /auth/register bị giới hạn @Throttle(5 req/60s). Nếu vừa chạy xong toàn bộ suite, vui lòng đợi ~60s trước khi nhấn Run lại.
